records.subject: How's the first week going?
records.body:
Hi Isla,

Checking in on how Union Systems is settling into Wrenfield. If anything feels clunky or confusing, I'd genuinely like to hear about it.

Best,
Nadia Goldberg

records.subject: Getting started with Wrenfield
records.body:
Hi Isla,

Welcome to Wrenfield. If you're bringing a team along, a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time, and seats can be added any time from Account Settings.

I'm around if you need anything.

Best,
Nadia Goldberg

records.text: :tada: New signup: *Union Systems* just joined on the team plan!

decisions.rationale: 6 days in on Team plan with zero response to two outreach emails (email:10f2032d, email:e4d219ac), no tickets, no project, no invite sent. Complete silence plus three stall reasons suggests low unaided momentum, though paid Team plan implies some intent.

draft.subject: A quick hand with your first project in Wrenfield
draft.body:
Hi Isla,

I haven't heard back since my note last week, so I wanted to check in once more before the week gets away from us.

If it's useful, projects are the main organizing unit in Wrenfield, and tasks live inside them — the in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project. When you're ready to bring the Union Systems team in, a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Would a short call this week help? I'm happy to walk through your first project with you and answer anything that's come up.

Best,
Nadia
